misprints.printed: ἐπί l. εἰς τοῦτο L τοσοῦτο
misprints.probably_meant: ἐπί l. εἰς τοῦτο l. τοσοῦτο
misprints.note: Capital L with no full stop, where the abbreviation l. (eller) is meant.
The genitive ending is printed as γος in both Drinkare and Drinkerska; it is kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The circumflex on the genitive ending is clear, but there seems to be no breathing; I wrote ῆρος, not ἦρος.
The ending shows a circumflex and no breathing that I can see, so I wrote οῦ, not οὖ.
There is no breathing on ουσα in the print, so it was kept unaccented.
